dedupe_keys.name: r1hz residential 1hz energy dataset circuit level 1 hz electrical measurements from one burnaby duplex 2017 2019 simon fraser university

description: R1Hz, the Residential 1Hz Energy Dataset published by Stephen Makonin of Simon Fraser University on Harvard Dataverse, holds circuit-level electrical measurements from one side-attached duplex in Burnaby, British Columbia, Canada. Four aligned 1 Hz files give current, power factor, real power and reactive power for one main aggregate and 18 named circuit or load channels over 757 days, from 13 September 2017 to 9 October 2019, each with 65,404,800 rows. The final release also has hourly, daily and monthly interval energy, in-home-display readings, hourly utility energy, outdoor climate observations, a channel dictionary and a voltage file; a separate raw-data deposit keeps the original daily Modbus records, monthly climate downloads and utility exports for provenance. Both are free to download under CC BY 4.0, and the final release was published in September 2026 at about 3.6 GB. Coverage is a single home in Burnaby. Caveats: two acquisition outages affected about 0.2 percent of circuit values, which were imputed from observations 364 days away, so imputed seconds are not measured. Simulation uses are high-resolution household load and appliance behaviour for distribution feeder models and digital twin calibration. Related records: data-karachi-residential-electricity-consumption-grid and data-gridflex-heeten-household-energy are other household consumption datasets.
